summary: The CLI ships a 'serve' command exposing the lancet analytics engine (rank-authors, affiliation-growth) as a local read-only JSON API with the same parameter semantics and JSON shapes as the CLI commands; a regen must preserve this HTTP surface.
reason: The Lancet web portal queries these analytics over HTTP instead of shelling out to the CLI. The server is stdlib-only, loopback-bound by default (--listen), never mutates data, hides raw engine errors from response bodies, and is marked mcp:hidden because a blocking server mirrored as an MCP tool would hang.
validated_outcome: httptest coverage over both endpoints (success shapes, 400 validation, 405/404) plus a live curl against a running server returned the same JSON field names the CLI's --json output emits.
